description: Attach permissions to normalized Google Drive file and folder structs when permissions are explicitly requested in fields, while keeping default provider field requests unchanged.

comments.text: Implemented file/folder permission normalization and schema support. Added explicit-fields test to ensure permissions are only requested when caller provides fields; defaults unchanged. Verified with targeted Drive tests (23 passed).

Updated Drive handler/triggers public_map logic to recurse targeted nested keys (:permissions, :owners, :file) so invoke/poll outputs return maps instead of nested structs. Added invoke-level assertions in drive_test; all targeted Drive tests pass (49 tests).

title: Normalize Drive file/folder permissions
